exposure: Type of Cesarean section (Emergency vs. Elective)
Mode of delivery (Cesarean section vs. Vaginal delivery)
cohort: 106 postnatal patients (35 Cesarean section, 71 Vaginal delivery)
finding: There was no significant difference in early postpartum uterine artery blood flow impedance between Cesarean section and vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Uterine artery blood flow impedance was not significantly different between emergency and elective Cesarean sections.
